TEXT:
...And after that, our lives were filled with dizzying 
days.
Where would be a good place to start, I wonder?

Due to Kyousuke's and Nee-san's persuasions, my 
parents attended our wedding despite us being on 
bad terms.

My father-in-law and mother-in-law called out to us 
with congratulations.

Former classmates and coworkers came, livening 
up the wedding reception.

We went to Guam for our honeymoon and the two 
of us enjoyed ourselves with all that we had.

Since we've gotten married, I've been bad at 
cooking like always. Even now I trouble Manami-san 
about it.
And...
We had a daughter.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAMI
TEXT: Mummy.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: What is it, Kanami?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAMI
TEXT: Hair, tie it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: How would you like it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAMI
TEXT: Meruru!

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Yes, yes.

They're currently airing the remake of the anime 
that I cosplayed a long time ago.

I find it nostalgic every time I see it and I recalled 
my old dream.

I wonder if I show my daughter photos from that 
time, what kind of face will she make?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAMI
TEXT: Mummy, you were Meruru before, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: *cough* *cough*

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: ...Who told you that?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAMI
TEXT: Bridget-chan.

On the television my daughter pointed towards, a 
familiar golden-haired and blue-eyed girl appeared.
She's grown up to be quite beautiful- Bridget.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: ...That rascal.

The popular idol Bridget, who was very active in 
Japan, graduated from being an idol and is now an 
actress.
She mainly acts in Japanese films.

When I look upon the scene of my former dream, 
my eyes were dazzled.

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN
TEXT: I'm home!

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAMI
TEXT: Welcome home! Auntie!

Upon seeing Kirino arriving, my daughter made a 
huge smiling face.
Kanami really loves her gentle and sweet aunt.

Kirino's been working overseas and had come back 
to Japan for a few years... Currently, she's staying 
together with us.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Don't call me "Auntie"~. I'm still only in my 20s~

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAMI
TEXT: Yup! Got it! Auntie!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Ergh...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: A-Ah, right! I have a special guest for today!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Tadah!

SPEAKER: SPK_BRIDGET
TEXT: Good afternoon.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Welcome, Bridget.

SPEAKER: SPK_BRIDGET
TEXT: Mhm.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: But, she's not much of a special guest, is she?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Didn't she come by just recently?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Eh? It's been three days, hasn't it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: ...It's fine though, since it's fun.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Right? Right?

SPEAKER: SPK_BRIDGET
TEXT: ...Ahahaha, I'm indebted to you every week.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAMI
TEXT: Auntie! Buy this! It's Meruru's!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
What what!? I'll buy you anything you want~! Ah, 
this? If it's this, then I already have it! It's the latest 
thing, right? I'll bring it to you now!
Kirino noisily dashed out of the living room.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'm home- whoa!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Ouch! Hey, watch where you're going, old man!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Shut up, you NEET. At your age and still living with 
family!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: That's for me to decide. This is my home, after all!

From outside the living room, I could hear that 
quarrel.

SPEAKER: SPK_BRIDGET
TEXT: Sounds like your husband's home.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Yeah... sorry about the ruckus.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...I'm home.

Together with the voice that I waited eagerly for 
every day, my husband returned from working on 
a day off.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'm glad I was able to come back during the day.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAMI
TEXT: Daddy!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Hey, sorry about that, it's Sunday but I had to 
work.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAMI
TEXT: Let's watch Meruru together?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Sure, all of us!

This spectacle, just how many miraculous events 
did it take to establish this?

I think about that every time I remember how our 
romance started.

I think about that every time I remember how the 
two of us made it here, despite a rough and 
dramatic journey.
There were people who gave us their blessings.
There were people who didn't.

...And there were people who, after many months 
and years passed, finally gave us their blessings.

And there were people who pursued the dream I 
gave up on.
And finally.

From now and forever, I will be with the people I 
love.
From now on, no matter what troubles arise.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: ...Welcome home, dear.
I am very happy.
